card.summary: The Patients Deserve Price Tags Act amends the Public Health Service Act, Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974, and the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to strengthen health care price and coverage transparency requirements. The bill establishes new disclosure mandates for hospitals, clinical diagnostic laboratories, imaging service providers, ambulatory surgical centers, and health plans, requiring them to publicly post standard charges, negotiated rates, and ownership information in machine-readable formats. It also introduces requirements for itemized billing, advanced explanations of benefits, patient hold-harmless protections against excessive bills, and enhanced federal oversight of administrative service providers.
